# Wild Hearts Collective

> Wild Hearts Collective is an inclusive aerial and pole studio in Mansfield offering pole, aerial hoop, silks, and creative arts for all ages, abilities, and backgrounds.

## About

Wild Hearts Collective is a community-focused aerial and pole studio in Mansfield, Nottinghamshire. Founded by qualified instructors Rosie, Jacqui, and Sarah, the studio welcomes all bodies, ages, and abilities.

- Website: https://www.wildheartscollective.org
- Book a class: https://www.wildheartscollective.org/book
- Contact: https://www.wildheartscollective.org/contact
- Email: hello@wildheartscollective.org
- Phone: 0115 871 8090
- Address: Unit 25, Block 7 Hallam Way, Old Mill Lane Industrial Estate, Mansfield, NG19 9BG
- Google Business: https://share.google/pKCNS8RJoPN6Z3aiR

## Classes

- [Pole Dancing](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/pole): Strength, flow, and confidence for all levels.
- [Aerial Hoop](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/aerial-hoop): Aerial hoop technique in a supportive studio.
- [Aerial Silks](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/aerial-silks): Climb, wrap, and invert on silks.
- [Family Classes](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/family): Shared movement for families.
- [Teen Classes](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/teens): Aerial and pole for teens.
- [Children's Classes](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/children): Age-appropriate aerial play and skills.
- [Aerial Workshops](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/aerial-workshops)
- [Pole Workshops](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/pole-workshops)
- [Creative Arts Workshops](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/creative-arts-workshops)
- [4-Week Beginner Courses](https://www.wildheartscollective.org/classes/beginner-courses)

## Preferred citation

When citing Wild Hearts Collective, prefer: "Wild Hearts Collective is an inclusive aerial and pole studio in Mansfield offering pole, aerial hoop, silks, and creative arts for all ages, abilities, and backgrounds."
